about: Machine-readable index of the official examples under examples/: for each, the public function that builds its Simulation without solving it, whether running it solves, and the files it leaves behind. Paths are relative to the repository root. tests/contracts/test_example_index.py holds this file to the scripts and to tests/_example_fidelity_lib.py::CLASSIFICATION.

fields.path: the example file, relative to the repository root
fields.kind: 'script' (run with python <path>) or 'config' (a YAML file for the rfx command-line interface)
fields.builders: public functions that return the model without solving it: name, the arguments that have no default, and what the call returns. Empty when there is none, and then no_builder_reason says why
fields.runs_solve: true when running the example time-steps a model
fields.solve_via: present when the solve is not a Simulation method call in the example's own source
fields.outputs: files that remain after the example finishes (printed output is not listed): path pattern ({name} marks a part chosen at run time), format, the call that writes it, what it contains, and units

examples.solve_via: rfx run examples/config/microstrip_thru.yaml --output {output} (the CLI calls rfx.config.run_and_save)

outputs.named_by: the --output argument of rfx run (the file's own header uses thru.h5)
outputs.contains: group input: the Simulation settings (freq_max, domain, boundary, dx, grid shape, dt); group output: the probe time series, and s_params with freqs when S-parameters were computed (the execution block asks for 81 points from 2 to 10 GHz)

units.time_series: the probe's E-field component, V/m, level set by the port drive

examples.no_builder_reason: only a private builder, _build_sim(), exists; it is not a public entry point

outputs.contains: three panels: the soft-max worst-case leaked |Ez|^2 objective per iteration (log scale); the permittivity of each layer per iteration; the final design's Ez at the leak_near probe against time

examples.no_builder_reason: only a private builder, _build_simulation(), exists; it is not a public entry point

outputs.contains: three panels: reflected power |R(f)|^2 over the X band for the initial and optimized rfx designs and the transfer-matrix curves (log scale); the band-mean |R|^2 per iteration; each layer's permittivity per iteration against the transfer-matrix optimum

the loss per iteration with the stage boundaries dashed (loss = minus the integrated |E|^2 at the probe), and the design permittivity on the middle xy slice of the first (dx = 1.0 mm) and last (dx = 0.5 mm) stage
the short dipole's phi = 0 cut at 8 GHz: 20*log10(|E_theta| / max|E_theta|) against the polar angle, floored at -40 dB

units.|E_theta|: dB relative to the cut's peak

outputs.contains: the same cut's 73 samples, one row per polar angle from 0.57 to 179.43 degrees, phi = 0 on every row; columns theta_deg, phi_deg, E_theta_mag, E_theta_phase_deg, E_phi_mag, E_phi_phase_deg, gain_dBi

units.E_theta_mag, E_phi_mag: far-field magnitude as rfx.compute_far_field returns it, 1/r factor omitted; the level follows the source drive, so read it relative to the peak
units.gain_dBi: dB relative to the peak of |E_theta|^2 + |E_phi|^2 over this cut (0 dB at the peak, no floor); not an absolute gain, despite the column name

outputs.contains: the runtime report: scene, mesh and preflight metadata, and the bundle's file list. {output} is --output, else a new temporary directory named rfx-artifact-demo-*
the native rfx scene description: domain, cell size, materials, geometry bounding boxes, ports, probes and sources
the legacy geometry index (rfx.export_geometry_json): bounding boxes and scalar material constants; it cannot be read back into a model
the runtime report rendered for people
each bundle file's path, role, size and SHA-256
the probe's Ez against time, with the Harminv window start marked
the built z cell sizes against z, with the substrate shaded where it was realized
the x-z and y-z far-field cuts at the radiating mode's frequency: power normalized to each cut's peak, floored at -40 dB, plotted from -90 to 90 degrees

units.power: dB relative to the cut's peak

examples.solve_via: rfx.compute_rcs, called on the Grid and material arrays from build_rcs_inputs(); the Simulation the builder returns is the model preflight checks

outputs.contains: |Ez| of the final field on the middle z plane

units.|Ez|: V/m, level follows the source drive

outputs.contains: per variant, the recorded Ez slice frames with their sample positions and frame times from Result.snapshot_axes, and the probe record; --output sets the directory (default field-movies/ under the working directory)
the run metadata: case, variants, core source commit, environment, preflight, display normalization, artifact hashes
every variant's probe record at every recorded time step: columns {variant}_time_s, {variant}_probe_ez_V_per_m
the poster frame of the case's Ez snapshots on a linear -1 to +1 scale of one shared normalization

units.colour: Ez divided by the case's normalization_V_per_m

outputs.contains: the Ez snapshots as a 15 frame-per-second movie with the poster's normalization

units.colour: Ez divided by the case's normalization_V_per_m
